{"kind":"table","sheet":"Execution guide","address":"A2:B13","rows":12,"cols":2,"values":[["Execution guide",null],[null,null],["Topic","Guidance"],["Scope","Current BrgySync admin, operations, finance, resident and role-control behavior reflected in the codebase as of November 9, 2026."],["Negative tests","A negative test is successful when the invalid action is rejected with a useful message and no unintended write occurs. Mark Execution Status as Pass in that situation."],["Test environment","Use disposable accounts and a dedicated test project or backed-up dataset for deletion, budget, cash, distribution and account-management cases."],["Two simultaneous roles","Use separate Chrome profiles or one normal and one Incognito window. Two tabs in the same profile share Firebase authentication state."],["Evidence","Record screenshots, reference numbers, timestamps and affected document IDs in Actual Result or Defect ID / Notes."],["Data integrity","After mutation tests, verify both the visible UI and Firestore/Realtime Database ledger or metadata specified in Data Integrity Check."],["Expected Decision","Allow means the action should succeed. Block means validation/security should reject it. Require confirmation means a review dialog is mandatory. Read-only and No change must not create writes."],["Execution order","Run authentication/access tests first, then ordinary request flows, then finance/distribution cases, and destructive deletion cases last."],["Regression","Re-run all Critical and High priority cases after changes to authentication, status workflow, registry, document vault, budget, cash, distribution or security rules."]]}
